reference_drawer.title: 📖 Sector & Arc Length Reference Guide
reference_drawer.description: Essential sector formulas and sweep applications.

items.rule: Area is the angle fraction of a complete circle area.
items.example: For 60° and r=6 cm, use the 1/6 circle fraction.

items.rule: Arc length is the angle fraction of the complete circumference.
items.example: For 90° and r=7 cm, the arc is one-quarter of the circumference.

items.rule: Perimeter consists of two radii and one arc.
The minute hand sweeps 6° per minute.
Wipers, carousel paths, grazing fields and pendulums can be modelled as sectors.
items.example: Multiply by n only when the swept regions are distinct and identical.

concepts.title: 1. Sector Area and Arc Length
concepts.subtitle: Fraction of a complete circle
concepts.summary: A sector with central angle θ is the fraction θ/360° of a complete circle. The same angle fraction applies to both area and arc length.

concepts.title: 4. Clock-Hand Sweep
concepts.subtitle: Minute hand turns 6° per minute
concepts.summary: The minute hand turns 360° in 60 minutes, so its angular speed is 6° per minute. Its swept region is a sector.

points.text: Use sector area with the hand length as radius.

schema_notes.strict_options_rule: Every strategy option and option_details text combines an instruction with actual mathematical content, and all formulas, values, or equations are wrapped in single dollar signs.
schema_notes.svg_rule: Every pool question contains a mandatory responsive SVG using viewBox 0 0 280 180 and sector/sweep geometry appropriate to the typology.
schema_notes.latex_compliance: All equations, worked examples and rubric mathematics use multiline aligned LaTeX with at most one equals sign per line.
schema_notes.guided_calculation_compliance: Every step has exactly two vertically stacked outputs and every field uses placeholder Enter value. Prompts and field labels do not reveal answers or intermediate expressions.
schema_notes.pool_compliance: Each of the five typologies contains exactly 12 unique questions: 4 Easy, 4 Medium, 4 Hard.
